limitations: No actual generated record or published numeric result was independently inspected in this review.
Tokenizer equality is tested through the validator API and a synthetic tokenizer here. The production tokenizer-only run belongs to a separate evidence lane.
An incomplete JSON status can abort the integrity validator. This fails closed and does not admit a partial arm.
Integrity artifacts and summaries are trusted local analysis products, not adversarial signed attestations.
The analyzer rehashes raw records. It does not rerun every tokenizer check or revalidate every launch-source hash after supplement creation.
The table generator does not recompute scores from admitted records. It preserves analyzer summaries.
P8 hardware, candidate live E2E, candidate free-running quality, and valid CDB exposed-cost attribution remain absent.
The final generator hash records the patched implementation only.
